      "reasoning":"The matching normalized email and repeated linked first-purchase promotion use strongly suggest multi-account promotion use. The packet does not establish the later facts required to confirm promotion abuse."

  "next_check":"id_check",
  "memo":"R06(b) and R10 establish Linkage alone. No other rule holds; no household exception removes these email/promotion conditions, and no earlier outcome settles the order. With no completed checks, recommend needs_check under §6.6(b), implemented as a hold with id_check. Decline is not permitted on Linkage alone, and escalation is not yet supported. Repeated linked promotion use favors promo abuse, but legitimate use of a shared or reused email remains plausible. The issuer-and-identity check establishes who holds the account and card, not promotion entitlement. No installment was due, so non-payment cannot support an adverse recommendation. The order remains unshipped."
